description.en-US: The bundle this component belongs to. Immutable: moving a component between bundles would change what two of them contain at once, for a price neither was set against.

The real variant this component is. Unique within the bundle: a combo containing the same variant twice is expressed as a quantity of two, not as two rows, so that the allocation has one share per product rather than two to reconcile.
How many of this variant one bundle contains, in uom_id. Must be strictly greater than zero, enforced by the domain service since the framework declares no CHECK constraints.
The unit this component is counted in. It need not match the others in the bundle: a hamper can hold two bottles and half a kilo of coffee.

Whether every sale of this bundle must include this component. A required component is always expanded onto the order; an optional one is expanded only when the customer chose it, which is what makes a meal deal with a choice of drink expressible as one combo rather than as one combo per drink.

Names a set of components the customer picks ONE of — the drink in a meal deal. Components sharing a group are alternatives to each other; a component with no group stands alone. A free string rather than a foreign key to a group table, because a group has no properties of its own: it is nothing more than the name that ties its members together.
